title: LinkAudit
description: Result of `rebar doctor --output json`: {findings, finding_count, pre_repair_tag_oid}. Each finding is a net-active blocking edge that disagrees with the structural link rule — `kind` is `ancestor-blocking` (an endpoint is an ancestor of the other), `mis-escalated` (the resolver returns a different pair than the one recorded, in which case resolved_source/resolved_target carry it), or `unreadable` (an endpoint could not be reduced). After a `--repair` pass each finding also carries `repair_status` (`repaired` or `unrepairable`) and, when unrepairable, a `repair_reason`. `pre_repair_tag_oid` is the tracker OID tagged `pre-doctor-repair` before the first write, empty on a read-only run. Exit 0 = nothing outstanding, 1 = findings remain.
